text:
Emma: FYI CloudMart just told us they need to change our Q4 minimum commit floor on the EU marketplace listing. They say one container was split into LTL and they need to reallocate SKUs — they're reducing our reserved pick by 18 racks until they re-route.
Jose: link? which manifest/booking id is this?
Emma: https://cloudmart.partner/manifest/CM-778 (partner sent the manifest pdf). Affected booking: CM-778-EU.
Liam: Oof. Which Dedicated pools/customers are on those racks?
Emma: A quick scrape: dep-a (2 pools), acme-inc Dedicated (1 pool ~ 4 racks), starstream (one small pool). I'll paste the customer IDs in #ops after this.
Ana: Pinging supply ops — @supply-ops-bot any clarity on split vs hold? Is this just a manifest change or physical hold at the terminal?
supply-ops-bot: Manifest shows the container was transshipped and split for LTL delivery. Partial pickup occurred; remaining pallets show ETA slip of ~7 days. Created internal ticket INF-2345 and escalation CM-778.
Jose: 7 days is tight but survivable for most hosted flows. Problem is Dedicated customers expecting pinned racks. Can we borrow spare capacity in other regions temporarily?
Liam: Cross-region will break data residency for some Private/Dedicated customers. Not an option for acme-inc. We can offer hosted as an interim but need opt-in.
Ana: Triage options: 1) Escalate to CloudMart to prioritize our racks 2) Shift impacted Dedicated to hosted shared pool (token/isolation controls) 3) Pay expedited freight to get partial inventory earlier 4) Offer credits + rollouts delay to customers. Need cost/impact numbers.
Emma: Partner rep says they can reassign 6 racks from their backup pool but ETA is 12 days, or we can pay expedited for 2 racks to get them in 3 days. No free fast path.
Jose: What's the expedited cost?
Emma: Partner quoted ~$7k per rack for air-expedite (rough estimate).
Liam: Not great. If we pay, that should be targeted to the highest SLA/most impacted customer only.
Ana: I propose: - Ask CloudMart to re-prioritize via escalation (we should push them first) - Move two smallest Dedicated pools to hosted temporarily (inform customers + opt-in) - If partner won't reprioritize, pay expedited for 2 racks for acme-inc only - Prepare credits and comms for affected customers
Jose: Agreed. I'll draft the comms with sales and legal. I'll also open a ticket to adjust commitments in the console so billing doesn't overcharge.
Emma: I'm updating the capacity forecast and reservations table now — will mark 18 racks as "pending reschedule" and annotate with INF-2345 and CM-778.
Ana: I'll create a short runbook: trigger = total available racks for Dedicated in EU < required by active commitments; rollback = shift to hosted + notify. I'll add metrics: latency delta >15% or error rate >2% as rollback triggers.
supply-ops-bot: Escalation update: CloudMart acknowledged CM-778, said they can reprioritize 6 racks if we accept later ETA or pay for expedite. Escalation ID assigned to partner ops.
Jose: Ok. Action items: Jose -> lead partner escalation & comms; Emma -> update console/reservation + forecast; Ana -> runbook + billing adjustments; Liam -> list data-residency-sensitive customers and confirm which cannot be moved.
Emma: I'll also flag the Dedicated customers in the console with a "marketplace disruption" tag so SRE/oncall sees differences in capacity.
marketplace-ops: Noted. We'll keep this thread updated with partner replies. Please attach any customer-facing emails to INF-2345 so we have a single source of truth.
Jose: I'll send the first draft comms in ~30m. If CloudMart pushes back, we'll reconvene and decide on expedite for acme-inc.
Ana: Thanks — marking owners in INF-2345 now. :white_check_mark:
Liam: Thanks team. Keep the updates coming so we can avoid surprise latency for customers.
